<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def boxes(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('N','W','B'):
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out.append((n['color'],min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs),n['pixels']))
    return sorted(out)
print("before:", boxes(current_frame))
res=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':34,'col':41}], intent='explore')
print("after:", boxes(current_frame))
print("res:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','no_impact','game_over','done')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
